links.comparator_used: Basic (unenhanced) form of each model with the initial prompt
links.outcome: F1 score for extracting disease involvement across 35 ESGO anatomical sites
links.effect: Top two models' F1 rose from 0.851 (95% CI 0.841 to 0.861) and 0.864 (95% CI 0.854 to 0.873) at baseline to 0.897 (95% CI 0.888 to 0.906) and 0.875 (95% CI 0.866 to 0.884) after optimization. Optimization also improved distinction between closely related sites and reduced left/right errors. The enhancements were a bundle (terminology list, clearer instructions, few-shot examples), so their effects are not separated.
links.quote: Following optimization strategies, accuracy increased further, reaching 0.897 (95% CI 0.888 to 0.906) and 0.875 (95% CI 0.866 to 0.884).

design_hint: prompt enhancement (terminology list, clearer instructions, few-shot examples)
